regression_fixes: Replace the previous approximate root projection and independent joint-gravity fall with Bullet rigid bodies, inertia tensors, contacts and joint constraints.
Calibrate F9 from 230 N s at 0.55 m to 165 N s at 0.18 m; distribute angular momentum using assembly inertia and dissipative angular limits.
Retain smoothed native lower-body animation; apply bounded dynamic/procedural upper-body differences rather than overwrite the complete active pose.
Keep independent per-bone reach envelopes, 0.28 m/s and 0.08 m foot cap, including a gradual return after contact ends.
Use a contact-window visual blend for special actions; retain the exact weighted-skin acceptance gate.
Exclude kinematic bodies from finite-inertia energy calculations, avoiding invalid diagnostics.
Retain standing-header candidates while receive assistance makes small sub-1.5 m/s corrections; native reach and skin gates remain required.
When movement or look commands are absent, motion queries use current velocity and facing rather than an unrelated default world target.
Preserve explicit queued first-time actions: an anticipatory chest layer cannot start or consume the ball while a pass/shot is requested; verify headers at three input timings.
limitations: This is hybrid animation/physics. Root and legs remain native-animated during locomotion; upper bodies track references with torque motors; all segments become dynamic during falls.
Recovery remains an assisted two-second blend, not a learned muscular get-up controller.
Motion matching searches eligible clip entries using pose, velocity and three future trajectory horizons; it is not an unrestricted frame-search controller or a trained neural network.
The 270 parameter contexts are numerical variations, not 270 new motion capture clips.
Only two short real-kick sequences and available reconstruction/reference code were studied. Full matches, all headers/receptions and exact video rotoscoping were not performed.
CPU teammates and opponents keep native movement/collision responses; there are not 22 fully articulated ragdolls. Stadium geometry is not automatically imported into each actor physics world.
Physical contacts are tested on weighted skin. Sparse software-rendered surface samples do not prove visually perfect contact for every possible kick or transition.
A pre-existing intermittent Chest_Run reception failure remains documented in docs/player-match-validation.json; this revision does not claim that separate case repaired.
Windows x64 is crosscompiled and PE/DLL/resources/archive/launcher/code equality checked. Windows GUI and a physical Xbox controller were not run here.
